explanation: The theorem describes the unit of the library's own adjunction `inverseImageFunctor f R ⊣ ...` on presheaves of modules. It says the unit agrees with the pointwise left Kan extension unit on the underlying presheaf. Mathlib has no declaration about this adjunction. I found no use of `pointwiseLeftKanExtensionUnit` under Mathlib's ModuleCat algebra directory. The statement's content lies in the library's own definitions, so I answered none_found. I did not search the rest of Mathlib.
